pages.text: Welcome, little one. I am Bluestar. Once I led ThunderClan; now I hunt among the stars of Silverpelt with all of StarClan. $(br2)We have watched you since before your eyes opened. These pages hold what we wish we had known when we were young.
pages.title: Bluestar Speaks

pages.text: Each of us has written what we know best. Spottedleaf teaches herbs, Lionheart teaches the hunt, and Yellowfang... well, Yellowfang teaches you what NOT to do. $(br2)Read a little at a time. A good warrior learns with their paws as much as with their ears.
